Zero hunger.summary: No supporting evidence was found in the provided context to determine the percentage change in Soil Organic Carbon (SOC) stock in agricultural lands within the project area during the reporting period. The context primarily discusses carbon stock changes in above-ground and below-ground biomass, as well as total carbon stock changes in the project area, but does not provide specific information on SOC stock in agricultural lands. The baseline SOC stock level in agricultural lands within the project area before the implementation of sustainable soil management practices is also not specified, although it is mentioned that the predominant land-use change in the baseline scenario is conversion from forest to cropland, which results in reductions in soil organic carbon. stability than the increasingly climate-vulnerable earnings from slash-and-burn agriculture.
